marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots increasing to southeast 35 early this
evening then diminishing to east 30 Saturday afternoon. Periods of snow and blowing snow tonight and Saturday.
Visibility 1 mile or less in blowing snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.text:

morning.<br/>
